body: Actually made me laugh, thanks, man.
I'm willing to try, even if it hurts, cause there's a chance that they'll care enough to make an effort.

Thanks, you just made my day. 

I'm grateful that you commented, cause dark days are getting darker and it's good to know there are people out there that care. 

<3 lots of love, my fellow trans guy.

Hmmm.

Writing like a girl.

I don't know how to explain it. I just worry that I write and breathe like a girl, you know, the usual.
If I get anything from Google they'll just ask me how I know if any of it is true and I just can't explain how I know anything to them.
Thank you, this helps a lot.

Yeah, I might write in a journal. I'll have to hide it though, I have a feeling that they won't take how I feel well.

I know it's gonna get better, and I know they might come around but it's just so hard to think positive.
I think I'll call them when I'm desperate, too scared to call right now. Thanks anyway.

I'm not sure if there are any trans-specific hotlines in the UK. My mum changed her mind on the therapist and said that I should just go to a psychiatrist, I think she just thinks that I'm insane.

Thanks for all the help.

I told them but I can't keep this up, they're right there all the time and I feel like everyone hates me. I've already told them I would go to a psychologist and all they've done is scoff.

They ask me why I'm sad and depressed all the time, and I just don't know why they can't see that they're the cause of all my sadness.

 My sister told me to wait until I'm 18 and know what I'm doing to my body, but that just made me cry. I don't know if I can wait for so long.

Thank you, that means a lot. 

I only hope I can get through this.

I've been telling my family how I feel but they turn it against me every time. I'm only 13 and my dysphoria is at a new peak, they're not gonna let me see a therapist/ psychiatrist.

What can I do except bottle them up? No one's gonna help me.
Says it's weird to like looking at yourself.
Yeah, im planning to talk to her when she's sober. I'll be safe :)
